title: HB3836 (2025 Regular): Relating to firearm transfers; prescribing an effective date.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Oregon) (gun-policy Stage 5, Oregon); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Oregon text (Introduced, official copy, https://olis.oregonlegislature.gov/liz/2025R1/Downloads/MeasureDocument/HB3836/Introduced; sha256 f80b5a155bb5fa94eb644e46372dd3c584f67b76e53de13cfa466b9043d7b20e)
provenance.note: Introduced version; no votes on file. SECTION 1 (ORS 166.412) has gun dealers ask the system, not the department, to run the criminal history check; SECTIONS 2 and 3 (ORS 166.435, 166.436) make matching changes for private transfers and gun shows; those sections mix struck and added words, so they are described, not quoted. SECTION 13 makes the changes operative January 1, 2026 for transfers on or after that date, which has passed; the text as filed carries that date. The section 1 definition above is the digest-listed change (new definition, not old law).

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (ORS 166.412): “System” means the National Instant Criminal Background Check System established under 34 U.S.C. 40901.
SECTION 4 (ORS 166.414): The department shall establish a reduced fee for subsequent criminal background checks on the same recipient that are performed during the same day between the hours of 8 a.m. and 10 p.m.
SECTION 12 (repeal): ORS 166.434 is repealed.
